changelog:
Initial release of project-management-governance skill:

- Introduces a structured, evidence-driven workflow for complex, multi-step project work.
- Defines default intake, planning, scope control, environment awareness, debugging, and documentation policies.
- Clarifies when and when not to apply project governance practices.
- Emphasizes minimal, reversible changes with synchronized documentation.
- Establishes clear handoff, progress reporting, and local learnings procedures.
